Shin Megami Tensei IV - Apocalypse.name: Shin Megami Tensei IV: Apocalypse
Shin Megami Tensei IV - Apocalypse.summary: Shin Megami Tensei IV: Apocalypse is a post-apocalyptic role-playing video game developed and published by Atlus for the Nintendo 3DS. It is set in the same universe as Shin Megami Tensei IV and forms part of the Shin Megami Tensei series, the central series of the Megami Tensei franchise.
